changes.diagnosis: the declared generic QC (300-6,000 genes, mitochondrial <= 0.10) kept 6,643 cells more than the paper; they flood two sink clusters (cluster 109: 3,467 cells vs 63 published; cluster 18, non-neuronal "undefined": 3,207 vs 363), while the margin rule under-fills the others (median recovery 0.49)

change.qc: the authors' Methods (Allen et al. 2020, "Data analysis with seurat"): per replicate, genes expressed in fewer than 3 GEMs removed; GEMs with < 1,200 or > 10,000 UMI, < 200 genes or > 15% mitochondrial UMI removed
change.check: must reproduce the paper's 26,768 cells (2,590, 9,060, 6,522, 8,596 per replicate) within 1% overall and per replicate, else the run stops
